meta.description: The Configurator clicked on stone, a chest and air through ServerPlayerGameMode.useItemOn: every mode, sneaking or not, every face.
meta.fields: marks [target, mode, sneak, face]; target; mode (ConfiguratorMode serialized name); sneak; face (the world Direction clicked, the machine faces north: north is its front); relative_side (RelativeSide.fromDirections(facing, face) serialized name, only for a tile with a facing); result {class (InteractionResult record: Success, Fail, Pass, TryEmptyHandInteraction), consumes_action, swing_source, was_item_interaction, held_item_transformed} of ServerPlayerGameMode.useItemOn(serverPlayer, level, stack, MAIN_HAND, BlockHitResult) (the call chain is: onItemUseFirst, then BlockState.useItemOn when the player is not sneaking with an item in hand, BlockState.useWithoutItem when that returns TryEmptyHand, then Item.useOn); exception (class and message when the call threw; the case continues); menu (the player's containerMenu after the call: {type: menu type id, class}, or null when none opened; it is closed right after); overlay (the overlay messages the player received, Component JSON, in order); chat (the non overlay system messages); payloads (ids of the custom payloads received: an opened Mekanism menu shows 'neoforge:advanced_open_screen'); before and after: {block, tile (class simple name or null), facing, control_type, config {type: [DataType x6 in RelativeSide.VALUES order: front,left,right,back,top,bottom]}, ejecting {type: bool}, ejector {strict_input, output_color, input_colors[6]}, energy (long as string; the machine starts with 12345), slots [item*count per inventory slot]}; block_exists (after.block is the same block as before); drops (ItemEntity stacks in the world within 3 blocks after the call, sorted: {item, count, patch, configurator_mode, configuration_data, side_config, ejector}); player_inventory (the non empty slots of the player inventory after the call, same shape plus slot; the dismantled machine goes here via Player.addItem); hand (the main hand stack after the call). The machine starts with the item default side configuration, ejecting off, energy 12345, STICK in the input slots (3 in the infusion slot of the infuser, 4 or 5 in the input) and 7 clay balls in the output slot.
